summary: Your coral-reef monitoring concept is clear and well written, with a credible Gantt-based plan. To move from Adequate to Accomplished, quantify mission requirements, add contingency and mission-specific justification to the plan, and present preliminary technical results (e.g., orbit/STK). Also tighten referencing and figure captions.
next_steps: In Mission Concept & Rationale, add quantified requirements: revisit interval, spatial/spectral resolution, data latency, coverage, and design lifetime; also correct the ocean-acidification wording to a 30% rise in hydrogen-ion concentration or ~0.1 pH decrease.

In Project Plan & Preliminary Progress, add contingency/schedule-risk provisions and clarify task dependencies; justify the plan against the mission concept, and replace 'leaving it where it is' with an acceptable LEO end-of-life option.

In Preliminary Progress, include at least one preliminary technical result (e.g., orbit, launch, communications, or STK simulation) with brief interpretation; in Report Presentation, add a proper caption for Image 1 and convert Useful Links into a consistent reference list.

criteria.C1: You clearly explain the coral-reef monitoring purpose and identify users such as marine and conservation scientists, with references. To reach Accomplished, state quantified mission objectives/requirements (revisit, resolution, latency, coverage, lifetime) and correct the '30 percent more acidic' phrasing to a 30% hydrogen-ion increase or ~0.1 pH decrease.
criteria.C2: Your Gantt chart and task descriptions make the plan credible. To reach Accomplished, add contingency/schedule-risk provisions, clarify task dependencies/overlaps, and explain why the plan is structured this way for the mission. Also replace the end-of-life option 'leaving it where it is' with an acceptable LEO debris-mitigation approach.
criteria.C3: You report completing STK tutorials 1–4 and background reading on coral bleaching. To reach Accomplished, include a preliminary set of technical results—e.g., orbit, launch, communications, or STK simulation outputs—with brief description/interpretation, so the report clearly shows you are on track for completion.
criteria.C4: Your structure and prose are readable. To reach Accomplished, add a proper caption for Image 1 and replace the bare URLs in Useful Links with a consistent, fully formatted reference list; ensure every in-text citation matches the list. Check figure/table formatting is consistent throughout.
